caption: An observer watches the bottom cane block: it fires at every growth step and when the cane grows. Its pulse reaches the piston through a stone and the dust on it; the piston head breaks the cane's second block and shoves the item into a hopper minecart standing on the hopper (no rail), which takes every item at once (a hopper waits 8 gt after each item it takes); the hopper under it empties it into the chest. Water: a waterlogged waxed copper grate beside the soil. Copies stand side by side, 5 apart.

Two canes share one observer and one wire. The observer watches the east cane's bottom block (it fires at every growth step) and powers, through a stone and the dust on it, both pistons, one on each side of the dust: each pushes into its cane's second block, and the head shoves the item into a hopper minecart standing on that cane's hopper (a cart takes every item at once). The west cane is harvested at the east cane's next growth step. Water: a waterlogged waxed copper grate beside each soil. Copies stand side by side.
